links.outcome: Share of FDA device reports with enough information to identify an AI/ML contribution
links.effect: Of 429 reports, 108 (25.2%) were potentially AI/ML related and 148 (34.5%) had insufficient information to determine AI/ML contribution.
links.quote: Of the 429 reports reviewed, 108 (25.2%) were potentially AI/ML related, with 148 (34.5%) containing insufficient information to determine an AI/ML contribution.

screen.reason: Analyzed real-world post-market FDA medical device adverse event reports related to AI/ML to evaluate the feasibility of identifying AI safety issues from existing reporting systems.
